Calculate Peak Area

Source: R/peaks.R
ls_peak_area.Rd

Integrates peak area at a given emission line, with a local baseline subtracted (linear interpolation between window edges).

Usage

ls_peak_area(x, center_nm, window_nm = 1, method = "trapezoidal")

Arguments

x

A ls_spectrum() object.

center_nm

Numeric. Peak center wavelength (nm).

window_nm

Numeric. Integration window width. Default 1.

method

Character. "trapezoidal" or "gaussian_fit". Default "trapezoidal".

Value

Numeric. Baseline-subtracted integrated peak area.

Examples

spec <- ls_simulate_spectrum(elements = c(Ca = 5000), seed = 1)
ls_peak_area(spec, 393.37)
#> [1] 3.466782
